text: The Toronto-Dominion Bank is a Canadian Schedule I chartered bank. Its own Annual Information Form states that Canada's Bank Act bars the registration or voting of any bank share beneficially owned by the Canadian Crown or a foreign government, and caps any other single shareholder's stake at 10% of a class without Finance Minister approval.

source.name: The Toronto-Dominion Bank Annual Information Form (December 4, 2024), 'Constraints'
source.quote: the exercise in person or by proxy of any voting rights attached to any share of a bank that is beneficially owned by, Her Majesty in right of Canada
